storage: Airtight jar at room temperature, away from heat and light. Whole stars keep their aroma far longer than ground; grind only what you need.
substitutes: Fennel seeds (a pinch, about ¼ tsp per petal)

usedIn.raw: 1 petal (one point of the star), dry-roasted and ground into the Chettinad masala.
